fitHeightTip: Scale the character to fill the screen height
fitWidthTip: Scale the character to span the screen width
resetSizeTip: Reset the character to its original size
snapTip: Smart snapping to edges, centers & other elements. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely.
variableStateEmpty: No variables yet — add some in the Variables tab.
variableTrackerTip: Variable Tracker — watch your variables' live values update as you move through the commands.
eventNotificationsTip: Event Notifications — shows a label on the stage for the command currently playing.
